instruction: Based on the question I posted about my last t-shirt order on amazon, has anyone experienced color fading after the first wash? Say yes or no.
notes: Read-only information task (evaluation requires no database changes), so every action is a lookup. Chain: passwords -> amazon login -> list orders to find the latest t-shirt order -> show_order to get the product id -> show_product to confirm it is a t-shirt -> show_product_questions filtered by the supervisor's email to find his question -> show_product_question_answers to read the answers. The yes/no answer is nondeterministic at planning time, so show_product_question_answers takes an answer parameter and asserts (found-answer ?ans) plus the nullary (answer-known); the planner picks either answer-yes or answer-no and the runtime binding selects the correct one from the answers' content. supervisor-complete-task passes that answer and is forced last via (task-completed).
